title: isachne atrovirens
intro: Isachne atrovirens, commonly known as Black Funnel Button Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Isachne atrovirens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Furthermore, the plant's leaves and stems have been used in traditional medicine to alleviate symptoms of colds, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions.
